##Pull in metadata
```{r metadata}

meta <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata.csv")
colnames(meta)

meta1 <- metameta1 <- meta %>% 
  rename(sample_name = sample_id, 
         notes = Notes, 
         spc = gw_conductivity_mScm, 
         sal_ppt = gw_salinity_ppt, 
         h2o_temp_c = gw_temp_c) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = ifelse(sample_type == "EST" , "SW", sample_type)) %>% 
  mutate(location = "Marsh_weir", 
         date = mdy(date), 
         datetime = paste0 (date, " ", time_sampled_edt), 
         sample_datetime = ymd_hm(datetime, tz = "America/New_York"), 
         sample_datetime = format(sample_datetime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), 
         sample_id = NA, 
         old_sample_id = NA, 
         pco2_datetime = NA, 
         pco2_id = NA, 
         xco2_ppm = NA, 
         do_ysi_perc = NA, 
         do_ysi_mg_l = NA, 
         ph_ysi_nbs = NA, 
         dic_taken = "1", 
         alk_umol_kgsw_avg = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_sd = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_se = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_cv = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_avg = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_sd = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_se = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_cv = NA, 
         alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm = NA, 
         lat = NA, 
         lon = NA, 
         created = NA, 
         updated = NA
) %>% 
  select(sample_id, old_sample_id, location, sample_type, sample_name, sample_datetime, pco2_datetime, pco2_id, xco2_ppm, spc, sal_ppt, h2o_temp_c, do_ysi_perc, do_ysi_mg_l, ph_ysi_nbs, dic_taken, notes, alk_umol_kgsw_avg, alk_umol_kgsw_sd, alk_umol_kgsw_se, alk_umol_kgsw_cv, alk_mmol_l_avg, alk_mmol_l_sd, alk_mmol_l_se, alk_mmol_l_cv, alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw, alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm, lat, lon, created, updated)

write.csv(meta1, "../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata_FORMATTED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
